authority: FBM process capture only; no source, gradient, model-promotion, FINAL-opening, or private-data authority.
input_classes: public behavioral and semantic operator curricula
goal: Train all public N0 capabilities without meaningless early gradients through untrained downstream arbiters or vacuous DEV gates.
procedure: Map each objective to causal module owners, stage J1/J2/J3 on one complete topology, and require every named DEV gate to resolve to candidate-dependent coverage or executable exact-source proof.
decision_criteria: all J1 gates retained in J2/J3
plurality and uncertainty evaluated as distributions
matched interventions test relevant changes and irrelevant invariance
validation: Static proof and real CPU qualification pass on 4270bfa2; no J1/J2/J3 trained-weight DEV scores yet.
failure_or_lesson: A full topology can be staged without treating a random downstream module as learned authority; a named gate is meaningful only when its target and empirical coverage are real.

authority: FBM process capture only; no source, gradient, model-promotion, FINAL-opening, or private-data authority.
goal: Make DEV checkpoint selection and one-time FINAL closure independent of all optimizer-facing lanes and immune to cherry-picked histories.
procedure: Freeze FINAL and its evaluator before gradients; compare FINAL against every relevant TRAIN/DEV lane; select the first checkpoint satisfying all precommitted DEV gates at frozen cadence and follow its unbranched checkpoint chain.
constraints: FINAL unopened during training and selection
decision_criteria: FINAL opening gated on selected J3
validation: P39PN 576092 built and froze FINAL-v2 before gradient; no FINAL scores observed and no DEV-selected trained checkpoint exists.
failure_or_lesson: A held-out set is not independent when a supplemental training lane is omitted from the overlap audit. Static freeze cannot substitute for later empirical DEV/FINAL behavior.

authority: FBM process capture only; no source, gradient, model-promotion, FINAL-opening, or private-data authority.
goal: Reject a self-asserted pass or swapped producer while preserving a usable exact-head runtime authorization path.
procedure: Bind receipts to canonical clean source, exact config, producing implementation hash, executed non-skipped proof, authenticated training authorizer, and complete checkpoint/evaluator lineage. Verify consumers at each stage.
constraints: runtime authorizer does not mutate source HEAD
decision_criteria: unauthorized checkpoint cannot be selected or open FINAL
validation: Exact-head P42 576089 and P39PN 576092 pass; no P43 memory pass or gradient authorization result.
failure_or_lesson: A receipt's text is not evidence that the named producer or tests ran. The builder must preserve source and producer identity across every authority consumer.

authority: FBM process capture only; no source, gradient, model-promotion, FINAL-opening, or private-data authority.
goal: Allow continued J1/J2/J3 learning when an operating step budget is insufficient without changing the objective or selection policy.
procedure: Carry exact-state optimizer/step lineage, change deterministic data order on same-stage continuation, restart scheduler at stage transitions, retain nonzero LR past nominal horizon, freeze DEV checkpoint cadence and reject branched histories.
constraints: budget is an operating point, not capability ceiling
decision_criteria: continued stage sees new data order
validation: Static tests exercise resume and lineage boundaries; no full J1/J2/J3 empirical run yet.
failure_or_lesson: A fixed compute tranche must not become an accidental training ceiling; a zero learning rate or repeated sample order can disguise non-learning continuation.

authority: FBM process capture only; no source, gradient, model-promotion, FINAL-opening, or private-data authority.
goal: Prove actual cross-window supervision on each text-bearing semantic surface without wasting semantic compute on padding.
procedure: Audit every supervised candidate and multi-step target for evidence beyond the native window; check exact source-token placement and target preservation; skip only padded segments at the semantic backbone.
constraints: native window is not product ceiling
no padding-only compute masquerading as coverage
decision_criteria: all governed text surfaces have TRAIN/DEV cross-window examples
supervised target beyond window is demonstrable
validation: Static long-context alignment and P42 full registered CPU forward passed on 4270bfa2; long-context trained capability remains unmeasured.
failure_or_lesson: Long input acceptance alone is not training coverage. Each declared semantic surface must own labels that actually cross the native window.

authority: FBM process capture only; no source, gradient, model-promotion, FINAL-opening, or private-data authority.
input_classes: real replay and mixed-precision production paths
goal: Move reproducible GPU failure classes into cheaper CPU qualification and repair all affected production sites.
procedure: Localize the failing interface or numeric operation, reproduce it on CPU, audit sibling production sites, repair the class, bind the regression to exact-head static/P42 preflight, then rematerialize P39PN before P43.
decision_criteria: real replay adapters run on CPU
fp16 masked-fill uses target tensor dtype
all three affected streaming kernels checked
validation: P42 576089 PASS at 4270bfa2 and P39PN 576092 PASS; P43 has not produced a valid result at this exact head.
failure_or_lesson: The earlier GPU failures were interface/numeric failures, not capability evidence. A CPU reproduction and sibling-site audit prevent wasting another scarce P100 allocation.

authority: FBM process capture only; no source, gradient, model-promotion, FINAL-opening, or private-data authority.
goal: Avoid overwriting GPU evidence and avoid interpreting a preflight exit as a memory or model result.
procedure: Check root existence before mkdir; exit 92 if occupied; inspect existing receipt and active writers; reuse only a verified exact-head pass or choose a fresh empty versioned root.
constraints: no deletion or overwrite of evidence
no GPU fit claim without result
decision_criteria: no result shown in provided stdout
validation: Pasted sacct shows FAILED 92:0; stderr reports root preservation. No memory measurement was observed.
failure_or_lesson: The existence guard did its job. The builder must distinguish intentional evidence protection from OOM or trained-capability failure and must not blindly resubmit.
